review: I want to be upfront that I am not looking for a church and if this site ever pushes me toward one I will close it and not come back. I found this through a sleep playlist and I have not investigated any further on purpose. "Kitchen Light at Six" is on every night at seven in the morning when I get home from an overnight shift. It does not want anything from me. I came out to my family at twenty-one and my parish handled it in a way that ended my twenties differently than they were going to go, and I still have three saints' cards in my glovebox, and I do not know what to do with either of those facts. Five stars. Please leave me alone about it.
